$comment: Saddlebag's built-in routing data. To change any of it, put a rules.json in your Saddlebag folder with only the keys you want to change (`saddlebag rules export` writes a full copy). Lists replace the built-in list; rule titles and reasons merge by key.

reasons.prestructured: pre-structured archive: mapped 1:1 onto the game root
reasons.lml-package: install.xml at the package root: the folder goes to lml/ intact
reasons.framework: known loader or hook: root, tracked as a shared component
reasons.asi-sibling: sits beside an .asi: goes to root with it
reasons.dotnet-script: managed DLL that references the RDR2 .NET API: scripts/
reasons.dotnet-sibling: beside a .NET script: scripts/ with it
reasons.stream: loose streaming asset: LML streams it by file name
reasons.replace: inside a replace/ folder: mirrors the game path under lml/replace/
reasons.data: data file with no install.xml or game path: tell me where it goes
reasons.override-skip: you chose to skip this file
